units.source_text: 女人垂下了眼帘，轻轻吐着气。

en.t: The woman lowered her eyelids and breathed out softly.

units.source_text: 就那样，沉下肩膀，身子一动也不动。

en.t: Just like that, her shoulders sank, and her body did not move at all.

units.source_text: 简直像一头不幸的小狗，遇到了一个荒谬的难题。

en.t: She looked just like an unfortunate little dog faced with an absurd problem.

units.source_text: 这举动给男人的愤怒火上浇油。

en.t: This gesture only added fuel to the man's anger.
